description:
Better combat aims to make starsector combat more fun by modifying values, and adding a few small features.

current version:
https://gitlab.com/starsector/better_combat/-/archive/main/better_combat-main.zip

releases:
https://gitlab.com/starsector/better_combat/-/releases

almost everything is configurable.
Safe to add and remove.

Compatible with secrets of the frontier
Integrated with luna lib

With default settings, ships have a much faster top speed, but take much longer to accelerate to top speed. Along with this, the map size and weapon range is changed for longer range gameplay.

Added Features:
bigger asteroids
asteroids split on destruction
ship fragments move more when a ship is destroyed
PPT and CR reduced by ship damage(disabled by default)
Dynamic Zero Flux speed boost based on ship speed(disabled by default)
Random ship deployment when retreating
Uncapped ship and fighter speed

Values better combat allows you to modify:
map size
ship deployment location and spacing
max zoom out of the combat camera
how far ships reveal fog of war
weapon range & damage
projectile speed
missile speed & maneuverability
missile submunition properties
missile DEM properties
missile HP
fighter range & speed
ship speed, acceleration, hull, armor, shield, phase, flux, ordinance points, explosion size, PPT, bounds radius.
Phase global values
Malfunction chance and severity
auto retreat range
You can also modify values of particular weapons and ships using a query system.

Thanks to Liral for the map code
Thanks to Crablobab for the asteroid code
Thanks to Maelstrom for suggesting and testing features.
Thanks to Chiruno for suggesting and testing features.

Known issues:
ships collide too often and ship system AI hints are not updated
changelog:
0.4.7
changed asteroid detection to not use settings.json, only using using asteroids.csv when additional asteroids are enabled.
removed weaponRangeThresholdMult this functionality was moved to the new feature
added skillHullmodAbility feature that changes certain skills, hullmods, and abiliities. Some similar numbers are shared.
removed additional asteroids from better combat spawn in the simulator. This means asteroids in the simulator are essentially vanilla.
0.4.8
enhanced weaponRangeThresholdMult with many more ship systems and abilities added.
0.5.0
added breakSpeedLimitFeature allowing the hard limit of 600 speed to be exeeded
added multiplier and adder values to fighters and ships
added fix to invincible ships with zero hull
added getShaSpeedAddSystemMult and getNovaDriveFix, to hullmodskillability. These modify ship systems. Nova drive is seperate because it reacts very differently than the rest when the speed limit is turned off.
added defense id to custom settings feature for selecting phase ships
added instantRetreatFeature which modifies when the instant retreat kicks in, fixes ships dissappearing as they retreat while still visible
modified custom settings reducing asteroid size and HP, making ships more controlable, and makes fighters faster.
0.5.1
added missileLaunchSpeedMult
changed missileRangeMultiplier to missileTimeToLive to reflect what it is, and fixed it being applied multiple times for some missiles.

Better combat is a mod that aims to make starsector combat more fun by modifying values, and adds a few small features.

All configureable.
Safe to add and remove.

Compatible with secrets of the frontier
Integrated with luna lib

With default settings, ships have a much faster top speed, but take much longer to accelerate to top speed. Allong with this, the map size and weapon range is changed for longer range gameplay.

Added Features:
bigger asteroids
asteroids split on destruction
ship fragments move more when a ship is destroyed
PPT and CR reduced by ship damage(disabled by default)
Dynamic Zero Flux speed boost based on ship speed(disabled by default)

Values better combat allows you to modify:
map size
ship deployment location and spacing
max zoom out of the combat camera
how far ships reveal fog of war
weapon range & damage
projectile speed
missile speed & manuverability
missile submunition properties
fighter range & speed
ship speed, acceleration, hull, armor, shield, phase, flux, ordanance points, explosion size, PPT, bounds radius.
Phase global values

You can also modify values of particular weapons and ships using a query system.

Thanks to Liral for the map code
Thanks to Crablobab for the asteroid code
Thanks to Maelstrom for suggesting and testing features.

showcase video. Several fixes and updates have been made since then: https://youtu.be/mikU8sxLbuU
